title: Sprite manifest
description: Every sprite sheet the game can use (public/sprites/manifest.json). See docs/ART_GUIDE.md.

frameWidth.description: Width of every frame, in pixels (32).

frameHeight.description: Height of every frame, in pixels (32).

animations.description: The shared animations: which row of a pet sheet holds which one.

shapes.description: Body shapes: where hats and faces sit, shared by every sheet drawn on that body.

idleSets.description: Extra idle moves (a stretch, a look around...) that sheets can use with 'idleSet'.

faceSets.description: Face sets: one row of faces per expression. 'blob' is the default and fills in for the others.

sheets.description: Every sheet, by name. characters.json and hats.json point at these names.

row.description: Which row of the sheet, from 0 at the top.

frames.description: How many frames, left to right.

frameMs.description: How long each frame shows, in milliseconds.

perFrame.description: Per animation, one number of pixels per frame.

head.description: Where a hat sits: the pixel in the first idle frame where the bottom middle of the hat goes, and how wide a hat may be there.

hatFits.description: Nudges for single hats, by hat sheet name: pixels right (x) and down (y), and a different width to pick the hat's size.

face.description: Where the face goes: the pixel the face set's anchor (16, 18), the bottom of the eyes, lands on. Leave out to keep the face drawn on the body.

headOffsets.description: Fixes for how far the head moves up (negative) or down per frame.

headShifts.description: Fixes for how far the head moves left (negative) or right per frame.

animations.description: The moves, named idle-..., each on a row of its own after the shared rows.

file.description: PNG path, relative to public/sprites/. Leave out for a recolour.

from.description: A recolour: the sheet it's painted from.

recolour.description: A recolour: palette colours to swap, by name, e.g. { "cream": "mint" }.

animations.description: Only the animations this sheet changes or adds.

shape.description: The body shape it's drawn on, from 'shapes'.

idleSet.description: An idle set from 'idleSets', or a list of them to mix their moves.

head.description: This sheet's own hat point, instead of its shape's.

face.description: This sheet's own face point, instead of its shape's.

faces.description: This sheet's own face set, instead of its shape's.

hats.description: This sheet's own hat nudges, on top of its shape's.
